Creates a new dialog with title and default modal visuals.Centers the dialog and resizes overlay to match viewport.Adds a content node to the dialog body.Adds an action button to the dialog button row.Opens the dialog and centers it in the viewport.Closes the dialog and invokes onClose callback if set.Handles overlay click; returns true when dialog consumed it.
